hasselblad-true-zoom.description: Take smartphone photography to the next level with this Hasselblad True Zoom Camera for Motorola Z family smartphones. A part of their Moto Mods system, this camera mounts easily to the back of the phone using strong magnets and features an electronic connection for data transmission and power. The True Zoom Camera dramatically improves your photographic capabilities by utilizing a 12MP 1/2.3" BSI CMOS sensor with a sensitivity range of up to ISO 3200 along with a Hasselblad 10x optical zoom with a 35mm equivalent focal length of 25-250mm and an f/3.5-6.5 aperture. This camera also features optical image stabilization to help reduce the impact of shutter shake and offers Full HD 1080p video at 30 fps with electronic stabilization. Additionally, the camera features a physical shutter release and zoom lever for tactile control as well as a built-in Xenon flash to illuminate dark scenes.
hasselblad-true-zoom.name: Hasselblad True Zoom Camera for Motorola Z Smartphones

incipio-offgrid-power-pack.description: Increase your smartphone's battery life with this black Incipio offGRID Battery Cover . This cover is a Moto Mod for Motorola's Moto Z family of smartphones, including the Moto Z Droid and Moto Z Force Droid. It attaches magnetically to your device and sets up in a couple of taps. The 2200mAh lithium-ion polymer battery augments your device's own battery, adding up to 20 hours of use. Efficiency Mode can extend your battery life by an additional 20% by only recharging your device when its own battery dips below 80%. Designed for unobtrusiveness, the offGRID measures less than a quarter of an inch thick.
incipio-offgrid-power-pack.name: Incipio offGRID Battery Cover for Moto Z, Moto Z MT-381-BLK B&H

jbl-soundboost-2-speaker.description: Pump up the jam with the Moto JBL SoundBoost 2 Speaker Moto Mod in black. This Moto Mod snaps magnetically onto the back of any member of the Moto Z family of smartphones, adding a pair of 27mm speakers that put out a total of six watts of power for louder, more expansive sound. Speakerphone capability lets you use the SoundBoost 2 to take calls. An onboard 1000mAh battery lasts up to ten hours and can be recharged via its USB Type-C port.

features.body: Advanced nano-coating technology creates a water-repellent barrier to help protect against moderate exposure to water, such as accidental spills, splashes, or light rain.
features.title: Splashproof Nano-Coating

features.body: A built-in kickstand in the middle of the SoundBoost 2 props up your smartphone. This is designed to make the sound more immersive, and makes for a convenient way to watch videos on your phone.
features.title: Built-In Kickstand

jbl-soundboost-2-speaker.name: Moto JBL SoundBoost 2 Speaker Moto Mod (Black) PG38C01816 B&H

jbl-soundboost-speaker.description: The white SoundBoost Moto Mod from JBL is a snap-on speaker that easily fits onto the back your Moto Z-family smartphone. It features two 27mm speakers that output a total of 6W of audio power, so you get powerful stereo sound directly from your phone. The SoundBoost also features a built-in kickstand and its own long-lasting battery with up to 10 hours of life, so you don't have to worry about it drawing power from your smartphone. The SoundBoost installs hassle-free and plays audio automatically, with no pairing required.
jbl-soundboost-speaker.name: JBL SoundBoost Moto Mod for Moto Z, Moto Z Droid, Moto Z 89869N

specs.label: Compatibility
specs.value: Moto Z Moto Z Droid Moto Z Play Moto Z Play Droid Moto Z Force Droid

moto-360-camera.description: Capture everything around you with the Moto 360 Camera Moto Mod . Like other Moto Mods, the 360 Camera snaps onto the back of any member of the Moto Z family of phones and is held in place with magnets. Its two 150° cameras shoot 4K 360° video and high-resolution stills and four microphones capture 3D sound. You can edit your media on your phone, share it, or live stream it over social media. A lens cover is included.
moto-360-camera.name: Moto 360 Camera Moto Mod 89596N

moto-gamepad-console.description: Take charge of your games with the Moto Gamepad Moto Mod . Like other Moto Mods, the Gamepad snaps onto the back of any member of the Moto Z family of phones and is held in place with magnets. This Moto Mod adds physical gaming controls to your device and uses the Moto Mods connector for a direct link with your phone, avoiding the lag that can occur with wireless connections like Bluetooth.
moto-gamepad-console.name: Moto Gamepad Moto Mod

moto-insta-share-projector.description: Take a movie theater on the go with the Motorola Insta-Share Projector Moto Mod . This Moto Mod, designed for use with the Motorola Moto Z family of smartphones, attaches magnetically to the back of your device and pairs nearly instantly, allowing you to project your screen onto nearly any flat surface. Its 50-lumen bulb projects an image up to 70" diagonally. An 1100mAh battery provides up to an extra hour of projection time and an integrated kickstand lets you project at any angle. A carrying pouch is included.
moto-insta-share-projector.name: Moto Insta-Share DLP Projector for Moto Z, Moto Z Droid, 89866N

moto-power-pack.description: The Moto Mod Power Pack from Motorola is an add-on for your Moto Z smartphone that adds 2200 mAh of extra power to help you get through your day. It installs easily thanks to its snap-on design and adds minimal bulk to the phone. Moreover, its efficiency mode automatically charges your phone only when needed.
moto-power-pack.name: Moto Moto Mod Power Pack 89912N

specs.label: Compatibility
specs.value: Motorola Moto Z Smartphones: Moto Z, Moto Z Play, Moto Z Force Droid, Moto Z2 Play, Moto Z2 Force Edition

moto-smart-speaker-with-amazon-alexa.description: Add the power and prescience of Amazon Alexa to your Moto Z smartphone with the Moto Smart Speaker from Motorola . This 2-in-1 mod is both a powerful speaker and digital assistant. It docks to the back of your Moto Z and, once attached, gives you full access to Amazon Alexa, including a special visual interface that displays the answers to your questions on your phone's screen. Ask for sport scores, get weather updates, check your calendar, set appointment reminders, and much more. Much like the full-sized Alexa speakers, this Moto Mod has an LED light ring to let you know when Alexa is working on your query.
moto-smart-speaker-with-amazon-alexa.name: Moto Smart Speaker with Amazon Alexa for Moto Z Family

moto-style-shell.description: Add a personal touch to your Moto Z family device with Motorola 's Style Shell in Black Leather. This shell fits over the back of your device, adding a premium look and feel without the bulk of a case. It attaches magnetically, making it easy to switch when the mood strikes.
moto-style-shell.name: Moto Style Shell for Moto Z, Moto Z Droid, Moto Z Play, 89887N

moto-turbopower-pack-battery.description: Add an extra day of battery life to your phone with the 3490mAh moto TurboPower Pack from Motorola . This Moto Mod add-on is a 3490mAh battery that attaches onto the back of your Moto Z phone for extra power whenever you need it. Thanks to turbopower speed, it can deliver up to 15W of power for fast charging. When power is low, recharge it using a USB Type-C wall charger for up to 50% in just 20 minutes.
moto-turbopower-pack-battery.name: Moto 3490mAh moto TurboPower Pack 89929N

specs.label: Charge
specs.value: Up to 30 W with USB Type-C wall charger

polaroid-insta-share-printer.description: Turn your moto z into a portable Polaroid camera using the Polaroid Insta-Share Printer from Motorola . The Insta-Share attaches to the back of your moto z and has a physical shutter button for snapping photos. In addition to printing shots taken using your moto z, it also lets you print photos from social media, including Facebook, Instagram, and Google Photos. Photos are printed using 2 x 3" ZINK Zero-Ink Paper, which features an adhesive back that peels off, turning your prints into stickers. One pack of ZINK paper with 10 sheets of paper is included, and the Insta-Share is powered using an integrated 500mAh battery that can print 20 photos before recharging is required. The Insta-Share can be recharged using its USB Type-C port and your moto z's USB Type-C cable.

features.body: Press and hold the printer's physical capture button to launch your moto z phone's camera. Click it again to snap a picture.
features.title: Real Polaroid Feel

features.body: The printer doesn't just work in real time. Use it to easily print your favorite pictures from the time vaults of Facebook, Instagram, and Google Photos.
features.title: Photos from Now and Then

features.body: Print your 2 x 3" photos on the spot with the included ZINK Zero-Ink Paper. No ink is required, and once your photos print, peel off the adhesive backs and stick them anywhere to share the fun.
features.title: ZINK Zero-Ink Paper

features.body: Before you print your photos, amp up the creativity by adding filters, borders, and stickers. Then, pick your favorites and print, and share them with friends.
features.title: Filter Life

polaroid-insta-share-printer.name: Motorola Polaroid Insta-Share Printer 201460

specs.value: 1 x Built-In Rechargeable, 500 mAh (20 Prints per Charge)

tumi-power-pack.description: Add additional battery life to your phone, without adding bulk, using the sleek TUMI Power Pack Moto Mod from Moto . This mod is compatible with both the Moto Z Droid and Moto Z Force Droid. It's a slim 2220mAh battery pack that gives your phone up to 22 hours of additional battery power. It snaps onto the back of your phone quickly, and is only 0.27" thin. Snap it on when your battery is running low, or always keep it on to extend normal battery life.
tumi-power-pack.name: Moto TUMI Power Pack Moto Mod

specs.label: Compatibility
specs.value: Moto Z Droid, Moto Z Force Droid
